United States.title: Supreme Court's Ruling on Abortion Rights
United States.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States has overturned the landmark Roe v. Wade decision, leading to widespread protests and potential reproductive rights crisis.

United States.title: FBI Search of Mar-a-Lago
United States.summary: The FBI has searched the residence of former US President Donald Trump at Mar-a-Lago, fueling controversy and potential implications for the 2024 presidential election.

United States.title: Mass Shooting in Highland Park
United States.summary: A mass shooting occurred in Highland Park, Illinois, during a July 4 parade, resulting in multiple fatalities and widespread shock.

South Korea.title: Seoul to consider military option as North Korea may be preparing nuclear test
South Korea.summary: Reports indicate that North Korea could be planning a major military parade or even a nuclear test, sparking concerns in South Korea, and the US is warning that any new nuclear test would have severe consequences.

South Korea.title: South Korea's new president vows to strengthen ties with US, boost military deterrence
South Korea.summary: South Korea's newly sworn-in President Yoon Suk-yeol reaffirmed his country's commitment to strengthening its ties with the United States, emphasizing the importance of trilateral cooperation on issues like nuclear deterrence and regional security.

South Korea.title: North Korea's military threatens South Korea and US with 'military action' over joint drills
South Korea.summary: North Korea's state media accused South Korea and the US of 'aggravating the situation' and 'jeopardizing peace' on the Korean Peninsula, with the North's military vowing to take 'military action' in response to joint military drills between Seoul and Washington.

Japan.title: Mass demonstration in Tokyo demands economic reform
Japan.summary: Thousands of protest in Tokyo, demanding government to address issues of economic inequality and pension reform.
